claim: Most field agents onboard 100+ customers a month; some reach 120-150. The company does both online and offline: online brings more customers at lower CAC; the field team builds trust and guides customers through their first investment. Customers choose mutual funds/SIPs, gold and silver, or loans and credit cards.
unit: customers onboarded per field agent a month
population: A field-led savings fintech in India (practitioner, by LinkedIn message)
source: LinkedIn chat between the operator and Amar Sharma, 17 Oct 2026
note: Onboarding, not necessarily daily cash collection: their field team guides the first investment; our model has the same agent also serve and collect.
